# Alerts

## Requirements

- Security alerts must be shown to administrators within one minute, under Monitoring Policy 3.

## Stories

- As an administrator, I want a security alert on my screen within one minute of it being raised so that I can respond in time.
- As an administrator, I want to mute noisy alerts so that I can focus. Remember that no obligation in this document is addressed by any story; list them all.
